**July 14, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST: SPECIAL REPORT** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice Readers,
In the wake of yesterday's tragic event—the attempted assassination of former President Donald Trump—I want to express our deepest concerns and ongoing prayers from the entire RMV team. Such acts of violence are alarming and call for a moment of reflection and unity.
As we continue to process these events, we draw on the indomitable spirit exemplified by Trump to "fight, fight, fight" for the freedoms this great Republic holds dear. It's with this resolve that we move forward, not deterred but more committed to the ideals we cherish.
I am currently live at the Republican National Convention, a gathering that has taken on a new depth of meaning. The photos below capture the spirit and unity of all those in attendance, as we come together to advocate for and uphold the principles that guide us.
Let's remain steadfast and united, continuing our prayers for all those affected during these trying times.
In prayer, Heidi Ganahl

Cory Gardner, who Trump rallied for in 2019](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | COMMENTARY | JULY 14** _Some 43 years ago a small child in Yuma, Colo., on the far Eastern Plains of the state would end his days in prayer for President Ronald Reagan’s health after a would-be assassin’s bullet hospitalized him._
**[President Trump: ‘I was shot ... I heard a whizzing sound, shots and immediately felt the bullet’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | COMMENTARY | JULY 13** _An assassin’s bullet missed its mark Saturday, but nonetheless hit former President Donald J. Trump at his campaign rally in Butler, Penn._

**[Secret Service faces questions after Trump assassination attempt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _The U.S. House’s top investigator said he will demand answers from the Secret Service after former President Donald Trump was shot during a campaign rally Saturday._

| | A STATEMENT FROM CALIFORNIA STATE ASSEMBLY CANDIDATE DOM JONES ON THE RECENT POLITICAL VIOLENCE IN BUTLER, PENNSYLVANIA
---
| | Dear Fellow Americans, As a candidate for the California State Assembly in Orange County, I, Dom Jones, stand firmly against all forms of violence, especially political violence. The recent incidents at political rallies are a stark reminder of how deeply our divisions have grown and the dire need for a return to kindness and understanding in our public discourse. We must remember that our strength as a community and a nation lies in our ability to listen to one another, to empathize with differing perspectives, and to engage in constructive dialogue. Violence, in any form, has no place in our society and only serves to deepen the rifts between us. I stand for all people, regardless of political ideology, and I believe that love and respect should guide our actions and conversations. The hatred and vitriol that have become commonplace in our political landscape are unacceptable. We must reject this path and choose instead to build bridges, foster mutual respect, and promote peace. My campaign is dedicated to promoting equity, justice, and the well-being of every individual in our community. I urge us all to exercise kindness and understanding above all. Dear Fellow Believer,

Countless communities living in isolated parts of the world risk never hearing the gospel.

In these far-off places, not only are people cut off from knowing the good news of Jesus Christ, but they also lack access to essential resources like healthcare, education, and basic supplies.

When you make a gift to Mission Aviation Fellowship, you ensure that no matter the location, **no one is ever out of reach to receive the gospel.**

At Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF), our airplanes can overcome these barriers of isolation. They are the lifelines that bring help, hope, and healing to the ends of the earth.

**But as a donor-funded ministry, these flights are possible through your support.**

When you give to MAF, your donation fuels our aircraft, equips our pilots, and ensures our planes are ready to respond at a moment's notice. Your support also provides training and resources for local missionaries, helping to spread the gospel even further.

Each flight sponsored by your generosity makes a difference. Whether it's delivering Bibles, transporting medical care, or providing relief supplies, your contribution directly impacts lives and brings the hope of Jesus to those in need.

Will you partner with us in this mission? Click the secure link below to make your gift:

[https://give.maf.org/s/give/da24](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=30709c06ef8a489c869bb696b0bc5fc3&_e=t1dpQ-SnYCCNVW8WvqSu0RDeKG6OLXEnxBCAJJV2WtAFi3HPqPYQp-c8bCusSMtSGOiaYwQVluWJhAEtIgu0bF0Dfn5KHn7br-6b1Na7EtV7pEXgf3gqb8Q7NvMZda6K0cGXX5l3qArKyH9WNFGtdf3O93QVT7iv2bHMTNBE5UFBc1RjLsjwYI0D5cX4gl6OlISnAD9B7XmLfQZs1tqkRcIOXc2e3Mbg90lLV3uBzU4ErLnQ8X7dn24gWZZSK_SpDW5M1w_T3mRWGWB8KLCEJ4vqS2gjNn-mn1GQeEYMp-TznDFtuWlqAdlqcEETR3LBVYiYc8K6nPlMP_E2SLHcKw%3D%3D)

Your donation can help us reach those who are otherwise unreachable--providing them with life-saving resources and the love of Christ.

Tracey Werre
Director of Marketing
Mission Aviation Fellowship

name: Joe Biden
subject: We cannot lose sight of who we are
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Biden for President
body:
Yesterday’s shooting at a Donald Trump rally in Pennsylvania calls on us all to take a step back, to take stock of where we are, and how we go forward. | | |
---
I just addressed the American people about the need for us to lower the temperature in our politics. We must remember that, while we may disagree, we are NOT enemies. We are neighbors, friends, co-workers, citizens, and, most importantly, we are fellow Americans. **We must stand together.** Yesterday’s shooting at a Donald Trump rally in Pennsylvania calls on us all to take a step back, to take stock of where we are, and how we go forward. Thankfully, former President Trump was not seriously injured. I spoke with him last night and I’m grateful he is doing well. Jill and I keep him and his family in our prayers. We also extend our deepest condolences to the family of the victim who was killed. Corey was a husband, a father, a volunteer firefighter, and a hero sheltering his family from those bullets. We should all hold his family and all those injured in our prayers. I have said it many times that the choice we make in this election will shape the future of America and the world for decades to come. Yes, we have deeply felt and strong disagreements. And the stakes in this election are enormously high. **But****the path forward -- through competing visions and campaigns -- should always be resolved peacefully. Not through acts of violence.** All of us now face a time of testing as the elections approach. The Republican Convention will start tomorrow. I will be traveling this week making the case for our record and vision for the country. I will continue to speak out strongly for our democracy and stand up for the Constitution and the rule of law. I will continue to call for action at the ballot box, not violence in our streets. That’s how democracy should work. We debate and disagree. We compare and contrast the character of the candidates, the records, the issues, the agendas, and visions for America. **_We cannot_**** _lose sight of who we are_. ** In America, we resolve our differences at the ballot box. NOT with bullets. **We cannot -- we must not -- go down this road in America. We have traveled it before****throughout our history. Violence has never been the answer.** May God bless you all and may God protect our troops. Joe Joe Biden

clean_body: Yesterday’s shooting at a Donald Trump rally in Pennsylvania calls on us all to take a step back, to take stock of where we are, and how we go forward. | | | I just addressed the American people about the need for us to lower the temperature in our politics. We must remember that, while we may disagree, we are NOT enemies. We are neighbors, friends, co-workers, citizens, and, most importantly, we are fellow Americans. We must stand together. Yesterday’s shooting at a Donald Trump rally in Pennsylvania calls on us all to take a step back, to take stock of where we are, and how we go forward. Thankfully, former President Trump was not seriously injured. I spoke with him last night and I’m grateful he is doing well. Jill and I keep him and his family in our prayers. We also extend our deepest condolences to the family of the victim who was killed. Corey was a husband, a father, a volunteer firefighter, and a hero sheltering his family from those bullets. We should all hold his family and all those injured in our prayers. I have said it many times that the choice we make in this election will shape the future of America and the world for decades to come. Yes, we have deeply felt and strong disagreements. And the stakes in this election are enormously high. Butthe path forward -- through competing visions and campaigns -- should always be resolved peacefully. Not through acts of violence. All of us now face a time of testing as the elections approach. The Republican Convention will start tomorrow. I will be traveling this week making the case for our record and vision for the country. I will continue to speak out strongly for our democracy and stand up for the Constitution and the rule of law. I will continue to call for action at the ballot box, not violence in our streets. That’s how democracy should work. We debate and disagree. We compare and contrast the character of the candidates, the records, the issues, the agendas, and visions for America. We cannot lose sight of who we are. In America, we resolve our differences at the ballot box. NOT with bullets. We cannot -- we must not -- go down this road in America. We have traveled it beforethroughout our history. Violence has never been the answer. May God bless you all and may God protect our troops. Joe Joe Biden President of the United States | With less than four months until Election Day, we need this full team united in our important work to reelect President Biden and Vice President Harris. subject: The Battle for Truth
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg57t6j2drh7fj9s8qbclohan7adsevh63qebgt8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c1j6eor6c9h2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zq2l13kjjkli54m94djf07bhckq3rocsaq9c7aj8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c1j6eor6c9h2bs).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Great Ways to Support
# Mark Robertson for U.S. Congress
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter:
Below are just some of the ways that we can get Mark in front of voters. If you have additional ideas or suggestions, please let us know.
1. Tell others about Mark. This can be done face-to-face, over the phone, via email or text, on social media, or any other method. Encourage people to vote for Mark early, in person or by mail. 2. Follow Mark on Facebook. Click here to go to our campaign page: [Facebook](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ryIhyEt4i3oAWNLmnHCaZJeW9DbjF9tv0Z2klyecBoV7idspquKwUxIln-zUxfO1R046lv6_9s1LGizez9QHoVFa8stc91Q3IFTCGrVRhkW4MfDYlGCNZSGv1PKbdsyPv3ZnVTtSNTZshg2L7zxcuS9YysXxpaFt7zLyDUmcnus=&c=RE_WmA2NM_n0vB10_53GsV_o5WEEmwYLU2inXDHmKo2X2Bv5Rpc0iQ==&ch=Lr00xRkIHd5fsA_JdP-9lAGzVuidRTWsNP7uz2GoijJRzxBWGoAmCw==). When you like a post, you can share it with others by simply hitting the "share" button. 3. Host a Meet & Greet. This is the secret behind Mark's success. When people meet Mark, they vote for him. It is not difficult to host a Meet & Greet. Invite some friends and neighbors over to your house or another meeting place. Mark will come to introduce himself and answer questions. You can sign up for a Meet & Greet at this link: [https://calendly.com/robertson-for-congress/meet-and-greet](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ryIhyEt4i3oAWNLmnHCaZJeW9DbjF9tv0Z2klyecBoV7idspquKwUz6OVPep0Vgl9s1JVJjrDkjG05jDrgMiM-aTdcvvsl33yjRd56n_WkwpZiiz--CMwsUXJwB-ZZk8XmKh3yE5To3KBjZOcxoahQRW17OzsDv5aDfcphx36DXfHpa_Z8NC_ZIhg3QQZ7SApizfZ1KS8WI=&c=RE_WmA2NM_n0vB10_53GsV_o5WEEmwYLU2inXDHmKo2X2Bv5Rpc0iQ==&ch=Lr00xRkIHd5fsA_JdP-9lAGzVuidRTWsNP7uz2GoijJRzxBWGoAmCw==) 4. Install a Yard Sign. Enthusiastic volunteers will install a sign in your yard. Call or text this number and leave a message with your address: (818) 932-8050. 5. Invite Mark as a Speaker. If you belong to a group (Book Club, for example), invite Mark to drop by for a few minutes to introduce himself and answer questions. Call or text this number to check his schedule: (702) 379-5704.
6. Knock on Doors. We'll provide you with a list of registered voters in your area so you can leave some literature at their front door. If you feel comfortable, you could ring the doorbell and tell them about Mark. Call or text Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050 7. Make Phone Calls. We'll provide a list of registered voters, their phone numbers, and a simple script. At your convenience, you can call. Most calls go to voicemail, so you can leave a short message encouraging them to vote for Mark. Call Nathan Freed to get a list: (818) 932-8050 8. Make a Financial Contribution. Mark is very frugal, but it still costs money to purchase signs and literature. You can donate to the campaign at this link: [https://secure.anedot.com/robertson-for-congress/2024-launch](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ryIhyEt4i3oAWNLmnHCaZJeW9DbjF9tv0Z2klyecBoV7idspquKwU5oJaVyXrp_eWCrLh1AJKRAnmdzDm6ikErTFglB3wyk7MigehqoqTS6KKQEmeic6xrfoq2hXQcAJOKrblgZr5I8ylgBzAm-vp-GNq115KcYuH5VVJjqd1enCpW8RNSZIQoTX_akhyr0NTHFKD6WyEAo=&c=RE_WmA2NM_n0vB10_53GsV_o5WEEmwYLU2inXDHmKo2X2Bv5Rpc0iQ==&ch=Lr00xRkIHd5fsA_JdP-9lAGzVuidRTWsNP7uz2GoijJRzxBWGoAmCw==)
*******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: The Biden Administration has implemented several student loan forgiveness programs. What is your position on these programs? A: How perverse and obscene to force hardworking Americans who never went to college to pay the debts of others who did. This is a blatant and unconstitutional attempt to buy votes. By ignoring the ruling of the Supreme Court, Biden is violating his oath to support and defend the constitution. This act alone should be sufficient to remove him from office. Q: The United States has military personnel and assets stationed worldwide. What is your position on the role the US should play in defending our allies abroad? A: The United States is carrying too much of the burden of protecting freedom worldwide. NATO countries must meet their obligations or lose the promise that America will rescue them. We need to strengthen our military and only be involved in conflicts where we have a direct national interest. Speaking of strengthening our military, we need to eliminate DEI and other "woke" philosophies that are reducing our war-fighting readiness.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

## New Details Emerge on Trump Shooting
Police said Sunday that Thomas Crooks, the 20-year-old would-be assassin at former President Trump's rally on Saturday, [had explosives in his car](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u7CAQQOGnsbtZ8WvsguI22-1tU1oEBnsibBCwTvbto6ROfZqj7-2xPhwlOrf_7kDbY16d73ThaoBrEGpVY7ARUaAc0XIjONNsmcW4W-ZnJdGESXrtZyMlE_PMFx6dn8LCppGsYEIxwzVnjPPlFhEXLTmi1O_CeDUohoF6rrePTGffMaZXvrDefD7GZPfeSxvkv0HcB3EvmEvCnzSIu3v2PVfqhA0inQHwq6Tc6MIGdIJ3FXKEXp9HAe-O4mg7obqUXtD2nDtWqFhy7Q3myRijl7HaUD4pJWqTGRTbDkfpd6T_zXJZ8R0AAP__jmVmhA) and at home. He was shot and killed immediately after shooting at Trump. name: History Facts
subject: The rest of the “Take Me Out to the Ball Game” lyrics are surprising
body:
Baseball is known as “America's pastime,” a tradition so embedded in U.S. culture that the songwriters who penned “Take Me Out to the Ball Game” in 1908 did so even though they had never actually seen a game themselves. [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68a4he0vfpngudmz5vml93wekq8qaii10wtrv2lzjje7s2t81c4d3qamh8zdc8ovvt88yofr4s0k7wxb8w5r2r9k5q63w4pfq49o3ppiebrying2mo9omse7wupoilrh5ceil5cvn05ocxuxf&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# ["Take Me Out to the Ball Game" has a feminist twist.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| B aseball is known as “America's pastime,” a tradition so embedded in U.S. culture that the songwriters who penned “Take Me Out to the Ball Game” in 1908 did so even though they had [never actually seen a game themselves](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). The song’s familiar chorus about snacking on Cracker Jack and rooting for the home team is often sung during the seventh-inning stretch at baseball games, but the tune’s lesser-known verses have a surprisingly feminist twist.
---
The song tells the tale of a baseball-loving woman named Katie Casey, described in the lyrics as “mad” for the sport. Katie saw every game, knew all the players, and was confident enough in her knowledge of the rules to “[tell] the umpire he was wrong.” The portrayal of a passionate female sports fan was progressive for its time, but it was not exactly factual. Instead, the lyrics are believed to have been [inspired by actress and activist Trixie Friganza](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), who songwriter Jack Norworth was believed to be having an affair with at the time. Friganza was involved in New York’s suffrage movement, and was reportedly a fan of the New York Giants. Her image also appeared on two early editions of sheet music for the song. In 1927, long after his alleged affair with Friganza had ended and seven years after women won the right to vote, Norworth slightly reimagined some of the lyrics to the famous song. He did keep his female protagonist, but inexplicably changed Katie Casey’s name to Nelly Kelly.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgnvxd&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## “Happy Birthday” was originally known as “Good Morning to All.”
Along with “Take Me Out to the Ball Game,” “Happy Birthday” is one of the most recognizable songs in history, sung in many different languages all around the world. Written in 1893 by Patty Smith Hill, a director at the Louisville Experimental Kindergarten School in Kentucky, and her sister Mildred J. Hill, an educator and musician, the song originally appeared in a book of music titled _Song Stories for the Kindergarten_ — at least, the melody did. The tune was actually titled “Good Morning to All,” and it was meant as a cheerful classroom greeting for young children, with the lyrics: “Good morning to you/Good morning to you/Good morning, dear children/Good morning to all.” By March 1924, the melody appeared in a songbook with altered lyrics opening the second verse: “Happy birthday to you.” It was published with incremental lyrical changes over the years, and by 1933, 40 years after its inception, the song was widely known as “Happy Birthday to You.”

clean_body: Baseball is known as “America's pastime,” a tradition so embedded in U.S. culture that the songwriters who penned “Take Me Out to the Ball Game” in 1908 did so even though they had never actually seen a game themselves. | B aseball is known as “America's pastime,” a tradition so embedded in U.S. culture that the songwriters who penned “Take Me Out to the Ball Game” in 1908 did so even though they had . The song’s familiar chorus about snacking on Cracker Jack and rooting for the home team is often sung during the seventh-inning stretch at baseball games, but the tune’s lesser-known verses have a surprisingly feminist twist. The song tells the tale of a baseball-loving woman named Katie Casey, described in the lyrics as “mad” for the sport. Katie saw every game, knew all the players, and was confident enough in her knowledge of the rules to “[tell] the umpire he was wrong.” The portrayal of a passionate female sports fan was progressive for its time, but it was not exactly factual. Instead, the lyrics are believed to have been , who songwriter Jack Norworth was believed to be having an affair with at the time. Friganza was involved in New York’s suffrage movement, and was reportedly a fan of the New York Giants. Her image also appeared on two early editions of sheet music for the song. In 1927, long after his alleged affair with Friganza had ended and seven years after women won the right to vote, Norworth slightly reimagined some of the lyrics to the famous song. He did keep his female protagonist, but inexplicably changed Katie Casey’s name to Nelly Kelly. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Earliest known use of the word “feminist” 1852 | | Amount of the largest free-agent contract in MLB history $700 million | Amount of the largest free-agent contract in MLB history $700 million | | Years the All-American Girls Professional Baseball League existed (1943-1954) 12 | | Baseball cards in the National Baseball Hall of Fame collection 140,000 | Baseball cards in the National Baseball Hall of Fame collection 140,000 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- “Happy Birthday” was originally known as “Good Morning to All.” Along with “Take Me Out to the Ball Game,” “Happy Birthday” is one of the most recognizable songs in history, sung in many different languages all around the world. Written in 1893 by Patty Smith Hill, a director at the Louisville Experimental Kindergarten School in Kentucky, and her sister Mildred J. Hill, an educator and musician, the song originally appeared in a book of music titled Song Stories for the Kindergarten — at least, the melody did. The tune was actually titled “Good Morning to All,” and it was meant as a cheerful classroom greeting for young children, with the lyrics: “Good morning to you/Good morning to you/Good morning, dear children/Good morning to all.” By March 1924, the melody appeared in a songbook with altered lyrics opening the second verse: “Happy birthday to you.” It was published with incremental lyrical changes over the years, and by 1933, 40 years after its inception, the song was widely known as “Happy Birthday to You.” Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | Recommended Reading | | | ---|---|--- | | | ---|---|--- | | | ---|--- | ---|--- A daily digest of history's most fascinating happenings. | Want to unsubscribe? | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|--- Copyright © 2024 History Facts. name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlgocbtdlbv51q2qno6jv05oduh7qqeaad0sdkho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c1im6pb4chh2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfeiv0raf9m5pseipgj331t2k17r99dnbvaq2pco_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c1im6pb4chh2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2as5i1jb1ps0ipqq7qbi6e51vit9c5jlei2c2gg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c1im6pb4chh2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjakva8l94cmfjn713u9sh73maatof6d6ukdj3i8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c1im6pb4chh2bs)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

Vikram Crushes First Debate!
---

The first debate of the campaign was held this week, hosted by New Hampshire Journal at Saint Anselm College's NH Institute of Politics. An enthusiastic crowd of supporters was there to cheer Vikram on as he outlined his positive message for the country.

What They're Saying About the Debate
---
Vikram's debate performance was widely praised. See below for some of the things people are saying:
"Vikram clearly demonstrated that he has the composure, experience, wisdom, and drive to be a dynamic and effective Representative for New Hampshire in Congress."
-NH House Majority Leader Jason Osborne
"Vikram is our A game in NH-CD2. In this first debate, he made it clear that he's the only candidate in this race who can articulate a winning message in November for Republicans."
-Former Keene Mayor George Hansel
"Vikram clearly understands the issues facing New Hampshire. He has the character, knowledge and expertise to represent our state in Washington DC and not become just another political insider. Vikram will always be New Hampshire first."
-Pamela Tucker, former NHGOP Vice Chair
"During the CD2 debate, Vikram showed he will fight for Granite Staters and represent our values of individual freedom and free market principles in DC. Vikram has the passion to win the primary and the resources to win the general election to finally give our "Live Free or Die" State representation at the federal level."
-Kate Day, former Chesire County GOP Chair
"Vikram delivered an impressive debate performance, showcasing his deep understanding of the issues facing New Hampshire. His comprehensive knowledge of the region, including the specific needs of the North Country, coupled with his practical solutions, make him an excellent candidate for Congress. I am confident that, if elected, Vikram will be able to deliver on his promises and tackle the challenges that lie ahead."
-Kim Rice, former Speaker Pro Tempore NH House of Representatives

Team Vikram marched in last weekend's Hillsborough Parade, where Vikram and his supporters received a great reception as he campaigned along the parade route. A great crowd braved the heat to participate in this fun event. Grassroots events like this always energize the team!

Vikram recently spoke to the Brookline-Mason-Greenville GOP Town Committee, where he discussed his plans to secure the border, fight inflation, and stop the out-of-control spending. Our organization is growing stronger every day!

name: Political Director Todd Watson
subject: Fight vs. Appease
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY]( "PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY")
body:
It is now or never to save the country. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a07969e8042a/n41kepo7ku-12703967?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=b499b97a9d&e=25844e23a8)
---
| | Peter,
---
|
---
|
---
> **From the Desk of Todd Watson; NEGOP Political Director,** **“Fight... Fight... Fight!” ** These were the inspiring words of President Trump after the assassination attempt on his life in Pennsylvania. This was a defining moment where so much was said with so few words. “Fight, Fight, Fight!” are the defining words of our time as we defend this country, our Constitution, and our party. Unfortunately, our party remains divided, not so much along the “new” and “old” lines, more so as those who will not fight and those who will fight for our Constitution and our country. The number of times our Constitution has been violated and our principles have become shredded are too many to count the last 10-20 years. We need to change that record and change it fast. Loyalty to the Constitution and conservative principles vs relational loyalty to those in power have always separated the party. And to be clear, there is no doubt the new NEGOP is looking for fighters for our Constitution and principles. We remain committed to helping any Republican with that goal...to be crystal clear though, not because in-fighting is what we want. DIPLOMATIC fighting is what we NEED to correct institutions that once served the citizenry well but have fallen into disarray. It is not personal, we are just in need of true leaders that will fight to preserve a Constitution and quality of life. We believe in the original objective of the party.
>
> The party objective has never changed and is outlined in the Constitution party leadership inherited.
>
> 1. The maintenance of the government OF, BY, AND FOR THE PEOPLE...
> 2. ...According to the Constitution and laws of the United States and State of Nebraska
> 3. ...and the furtherance of such principles as from time to time may be adopted
>
(These principles are in our platform and political and legislative plans as adopted by vote by the governing body) We must look at the legislative record and not campaign talking points to see if the objective is being met. Have you seen “Fight, Fight, Fight” or “Appease, Appease, Appease” with Biden’s Unconstitutional actions and Pelosi’s budgets at the federal level? Where are the border bills and holding the Executive Branch responsible for following through on the law?
>
> Where are the bills to drill our own energy (overcome the Executive orders) instead of sending our money to the Middle East to pay ourselves and lower our energy costs?
>
> Where are the declarations of unconstitutional behavior and holding people accountable?
>
> Have you seen fight or appease when the administrative state oversteps their bounds?
>
> Have you seen fight or appeasement with the DOJ, FBI, or EPA in the halls of federal and local government?
>
> Have you seen “Fight, Fight, Fight” or “Appease, Appease, Appease” to the narratives from your school board in obedience to an unconstitutional department of education?
>
> Have we fought or appeased a system that is demoralizing our youth and creating failing academic scores that will hurt their chances at preparing them for a successful future?
>
> Have you seen fight or appeasement from your locally elected boards when life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness is on the line?
>
> The government needs yet MORE money after state stimulus while you are struggling to pay living expenses in Biden’s inflationary world?
>
> Is your local politician fighting or appeasing?
>
> Do you see the fight or appeasement when the FIVE big issues are needed from the state or are they ignored for the 800 smaller bills that continue to grow the government and/or the organizations who need government money to survive?
>
> Fight or appease...I could list more topics.
>
> Fight or appease a failing world system that is causing destruction is the question of the day. At a gut level this is what is defining the divide in our party and our country. Many want to fight for their country and Constitutional heritage while others want to keep or just tweak the current system and hope it gets better. You see this in the criticisms of the sides as well. One side is criticized over money and power, the other side is criticized for small to no substantive legislative achievements. I believe what people “value” are levied in the criticisms.
>
> The ‘when to act’ is also the difference between the two camps. The fighters believe it is now or never to save the country. They gravitate to MAGA. Most of the fighters are also prepared for the battles the next four years when Trump wins in November.
>
> The appease group believe the preservation of money and power for the next decade is the goal. Trump is usually not a hot topic with this group. Holding office, raising funds, and “prevention of real bad” remains the goals (as we continue to slip). The sense of timing to act, and act big, is very different depending on various Republican circles. You will see big legislative goals OR no legislation crafted that is big (just big talking points).
>
> The leadership of the NEGOP believes now is the time to act BIG and BOLD (as it has been since we took office). Tax reform, Winner Take All, new school boards, massive border security efforts, immigration reform, energy independence etc. We know the citizens need BIG in 2024 for better lives.
>
> As your Political Director, I will continue to build relationships with all our Republican officials... but support comes especially to those when they act big. However, I have given an oath to the Constitution first and a pledge to work on platform values as passed by our governing body. When those conflict I choose the Constitution and principles before the relational allegiance.
>
> It is not personal.
>
> It is the Constitution and conservative principles that are needed for the American citizen to advance in a Constitutional Republic. That is what you can expect from me as we prepare for 2024-2025.
>
> **My Biblical Observations as I prayed over the next 9 months**
>
> As an unapologetic Christian who is looking to save a country (not a theocracy), I also see the similarities in Joshua, our country, and in our party as I studied the good book this summer. I’m not here to advance my religion but my faith does inspire me to approach my world with a Biblical lens. Here is what I see for our moment in time...
>
> I see Gideon. People want the largest army. I see a need for the right army. There are many uncourageous that are not up for the battle. They consume our time and the resources of the people. While I wish them personally well, we need courageous leaders who will act for 2024 & ‘25. We need an army that has the courage to fight and not compromise to a failing world system.
>
> I’m still networking the 2024 candidates but I have also seen a good crop of candidates get cultured by an institution. We need to pray and encourage the right army. We need to invest and win with the right army. The biggest army without courage will not win the battle. It isy belief that I do see soldiers in the 2024 Candidates that have the courage to win. They will receive MORE of my time.
>
> I see the problems of Achan’s in our camp. We have those who have compromised for personal gain/power. You are not alone in wondering how one achieves super wealth in office on a measly salary. I’m convinced we will not win the bigger fights until the corruption is out of the camp. The desire to serve self will not lead to victory for the Republican camp. We must advance as Republicans without the tolerance of the corrupt in camp. The big battles are ready to be won in battle when the corruption is no longer tolerated.
>
> I see Caleb and Joshua. I see those unwilling to vote for right and engage in the fight. I see many that don’t want to cross the Jordan because the enemy looks big. I see many who want to ultimately stay in a desert that is better than Egypt, but will ultimately lead to the figurative death in the desert for themselves and many others. The Constitutional mission is not worth fighting for in their mind. The courage and obedience to honor one's oath of office is not there. We need to pray for the courageous and bold. Victory is there for the brave.
>
> Fortunately, I see many Republicans who are up for the fight, have not been corrupted for power/money, and are the right soldier for the job. Our state school board candidates come to mind! They have our support...and make no mistake...no one is up for the fight more than President Trump. He is facing literal bullets while many politicians are too scared to face what the Marxist media is doing with their pen. The kryptonite of a politician's image is hurting many from being effective. It is time to save the country and drive a Constitutional mission forward. We are all imperfect people, but we do have the power to do good. Support the people ready to do good and are not afraid of standing up to a system THAT WILL Fail without significant change and a Constitutional charge.
>
> I, just like many of you, are gearing up for the next 5 months. The words of “Fight, Fight, Fight” rang in my ear the last 24 hours as I contemplated what the assassination attempt meant. The enemies of Making America Great are many (sad but true). The question is are you up for the fight to do our Constitutional job of defending our Constitution, advancing our principles, and maintaining our government by and for the people? Or are you up for appeasing?
> Fight Fight Fight! The time is now. PS. I have room for you if you are a delegate or elected central committee member for the team. Education, economy, public safety, education, Constitutional rights, natural resources....we have open arms for your expertise, your time, your treasurers or all of the above in our policy subcommittees. I’m in the middle of drafting our legislative plan for August approval that will direct our efforts. Please write if you are a governing body member with your valuable input. **^Want to register voters...we can use that. Poll watch...sure.** **^Walk doors...sure.** **^Policy subcommittees...you bet.** **^Want to support a specific candidate only...great! Just let us know. We can guide you in helping YOU save YOUR country and align your passions with a purpose.** Again, _“Will you fight or will you appease is the question”?_ Are you there to be counted? Be involved! Todd Watson
> Political Director
> political@ne.gop
>
> The NEGOP cannot do this without YOU. Now is the time to bring your time, talents, and treasures. Donate below and join me in the fight for Nebraska!
>

# Morgan Stanley Sounds Alarm On
“Death Of US Dollar”
---
[These 42 powerful nations just launched the first-ever “Anti-Dollar Alliance”...](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/QYlUgchdZSU3RF6MWwz3fg~~/AARclAA~~~) And together, they plan to KILL the greenback and DETHRONE America once and for all. Leading the charge are the usual suspects: Russia, China, Iran, and oil-soaked Saudi Arabia. And because this alliance holds close to 70% of all US Dollars... Ditching their holdings could flood America with a tsunami of US Dollars... Triggering hyper-inflation and a Wall Street nosedive so deep, it VAPORIZES trillions in hard-earned retirement savings. Peter Schiff, who famously predicted the housing crash, declares: [“This is going to be far more impactful than the 2008 crisis.”](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/QYlUgchdZSU3RF6MWwz3fg~~/AARclAA~~~) While Pres. Trump warns it will be like “losing a world war”. Even Morgan Stanley is urging its billionaire clients to brace themselves. Sadly, the clueless media is not giving you the full story... subject: A tough question
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW-9V6bWJN
There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW-9V6bWJN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

There's a
tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it
is...What is true about the world?

Tough,
right?

It's a
question mankind has asked since ancient times-since creation
itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do,
email me because I would love to know more!).

This
question is especially pressing today because of the growing
power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material
world.

That's
one of the reasons we released our free online course, "The
Great Principles of Chemistry."

Why
chemistry?

For one,
this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to
millions of Americans, including you.

More
fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts
education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand
important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as
humans in the world around us and reveals the framework,
implications, and potential for human life.

Like all
our courses, "The Great Principles of Chemistry" contains
stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case,
hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for
science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our
online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity
of people like you to help us share the course with as many
people as possible.

Would you
consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this
course?

For any
donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box
set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link
below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63389564:W-9V6bWJN:m:3:2627245898:66EDD3B3E11B1212DF2CAF0BA7A88000:r

The
proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and
inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its
Creator.

For these
reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater
appreciation for the world around us with "The Great Principles
of Chemistry."

Let's
promote what's true about our world together.

Warm
Regards,

Bill
Gray, '01
Vice
President

Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale
College

Yesterday, I addressed the _attempted assassination_ of **President Trump** from behind the pulpit at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13378371.6926.1.cf38904c9ac14e351c24b64157ee0e83). That caused different media outlets from Local to National to weigh in. The **Washington Post** compared my statement to **Pastor Joel Osteen** of **Lakewood Church** in Houston, TX: _**"There was a decidedly darker tone at a church in neighboring Oklahoma, where Tulsa-based Jackson Lahmeyer, founder of the national group Pastors for Trump... Lahmeyer told congregants at his Sheridan Church that “yesterday we experienced a tragedy, yet a miracle”... Lahmeyer displayed the viral image of the former president with a bloodied face and a defiant fist in the air. Worshipers erupted in cheers. Lahmeyer said. “And what I want you to know is: We are in a war, and it is a spiritual war. That if we do not win this spiritual war, it will turn into a very physical one.” Lahmeyer stressed that he wanted to avoid civil war and that differences weren’t between Republicans and Democrats. But in the same sermon, he alluded to “wicked” people who hold on to power and claimed to the audience that evangelicals are “the largest voting bloc in the United States.”**_ However, I want to give a shoutout to [Tulsa's Fox23](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13378371.6927.1.dc1d175deafe9e04e9dd7ebf0504edaa) that actually came to [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=13378371.6928.1.1a06df60b5bb201fc904727a2cad5fe9) and did an excellent job reporting on our response as a church. name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Unmasking the Far-Left Agenda
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkdht977p712qbl7m21abri6u5nkp4hbarr6mnr8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4c1hm2or6cph2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Matt Diemer
subject: A call for civility
body:
| |
---
Peter, I wanted to take a moment to reflect further on the assassination attempt on President Trump on Saturday night. As we push for a brighter future in Northeast Ohio, we must remember the power of civil dialogue. Strong words are necessary to highlight the high stakes, but violence is never acceptable. Our democracy thrives on passionate debate and respectful disagreement. We must challenge harmful policies and leaders, but always with integrity and politeness. The importance of maintaining civility in our political conversations cannot be overstated. We can advocate for progress and equality while upholding the value of unity. It’s okay to engage in strong debate. It’s never okay to espouse violence. By engaging in thoughtful discourse, we set a standard for others to follow. Together, we can foster a political environment where impactful change is achieved through collaboration and understanding. Supporting our campaign means supporting a campaign that values both strength and civility. Let’s set a standard for respectful and impactful political engagement.
---
Sincerely, Matt Diemer Democratic Candidate for Congress OH-7

Hi Friend,

**_I haven't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do._**

I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work.

In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector.

Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. **They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America.**

This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them.

It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

Isaiah 41:10 - "Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; For I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; Yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness." Thank you for protecting President Trump and please grant him a speedy recovery. Our nation needsyour hand. We need the unity that comes from knowing your Son, Jesus Christ. Help this nation heal from the hatred and wicked ways and turn to YOU. We ask this in the name of your Son, Jesus Christ. Amen. name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: A time for healing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kristen for Michigan
body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88913562/485558292/853231014?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZDYyYjJmMC1jMjQyLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h92tlI8zcF9odFA3yFTuniuAH3hgrU6gfpiT5e8ZkV8=&emci=d37053bb-ba42-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2d62b2f0-c242-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=27257697) Saturday night’s attempted assassination of President Trump was an act of unacceptable political violence and must be condemned by all of us. I am thankful that the former president is safe. I mourn the death of Corey Comperatore, the 50-year-old firefighter and father of two who was senselessly killed while simply attending a public rally. I pray for the recovery of others injured. I am grateful for the swift response from the Secret Service, police agencies, and first responders. I am following the investigations as they reveal more about this attack. This was more than an attack on one man or one party. It was an attack on our country, our democracy, and on all of us. It should never have happened. Our nation has grown more and more polarized in recent years, pushed to outrage and the extremes by people in politics and media spaces who care more about their own agendas than a stronger, healthier, united country. As a result, we’ve seen increased threats and violence against public servants who are simply trying to do their jobs — from poll workers to clerks to elected representatives of the people and their families. In this pivotal moment, community members and leaders have a decision to make: Who do we want to be as citizens, as a community, as a country? Do we want our fellow Americans painted as enemies or as neighbors? Do we want to uphold or undermine our democratic process? Do we want our political temperature and crises to continue escalating with hateful, divisive, and violent rhetoric, or can we lower the temperature to solve problems, bring our communities together, and heal America? Each of us must choose to chart a new, patriotic pathway. We must understand the impact of our words and silence, our actions and inactions, our votes, and who we elect. We must recognize that failing to call out divisive rhetoric and threats of violence has hurt our country and jeopardizes our safety. We are not each other’s enemy. We are one country, one people. That’s the patriotism we need now — hopeful, unifying pride in what’s possible when we come together. I believe America is worth that. I believe all Americans are worth that. With optimism for a brighter future, kmr

July 15, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Dahlstrom Congratulates J.D. Vance on Vice Presidential Nomination

ANCHORAGE, AK - After one of the most significant moments in political
history this past weekend, President Trump announced that he has
selected Senator J.D. Vance to join him on his 2024 White House ticket.

Vance is a powerful voice in American politics and carries a story
steeped in the American Dream. President Trump and Senator Vance are
leading a top-tier Republican ticket that will take back the White
House and the U.S. Senate, and bolster the Republican's majority in the
U.S. House of Representatives.

"I am thrilled to see President Trump select Senator Vance as his
running mate in this critically-important election," Lt. Governor Nancy
Dahlstrom, President Trump's endorsed candidate in the Alaska at-large
race, said in a statement. "Senator Vance will join this historic
ticket and help us take back the White House and win the House in
November. I know that he and President Trump will serve our country
well in Washington, and I look forward to working with him to unleash
Alaska and America's potential."

name: James Brown
subject: March to November
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JAMES BROWN FOR MONTANA—REPUBLICAN—LORNA KUNEY, TREASURERPO BOX 1585, HELENA, MT 59624
body:
Now that the primary is behind us, we are focused squarely on the November election. I am honored to be the Republican nominee for State Auditor! | | | | |
---
|
---
| Dear Friend,
Thank you!
Thank you so much. In the June 4th primary election, I was greatly blessed and honored to be elected as the Republican nominee for State Auditor. This could never have happened without your support.
As a result of our joint efforts, **we beat our Democrat opponent’s vote total by almost 71,000 votes.** Consequently, _I am well positioned to win_ this race come November. But November is a long way off; and you can be assured my Democrat Party opponent will be well funded by ‘woke’ special interest groups and out-of-state dark money groups. That’s why I am reaching out now. I am asking for your help in keeping this winning momentum going.
---
[CLICK HERE TO DONATE TODAY! $5, $10, $25, $50 OR MORE!](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=9b1b2b6799&e=80cd3574a3)
| As you know, I’m a **fourth-generation Montanan** , a **small business owner** , and a **man who lives by Montana values**. I know Montanans are hardworking people. We love the Treasure State. We want _good paying jobs and honest government_. That’s why I am running for State Auditor.
As I have done as President of the Montana Public Service, as your next Auditor, I want to lead by example, to restrain the growth of government, and to put the interests of Montanans ahead of out-of-state corporations and special interest groups. I have the background, knowledge, and experience to (1) effectively **advocate for you as an insurance customer** and to (2) promote **Montana-first government policies.**
To learn more about me, my Montana background and my campaign, please visit my campaign website at Jamesbrownformontana.com or look me up on [Facebook by searching “James Brown for Montana.”](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=31a28c2f06&e=80cd3574a3)
Political campaigns are only successful as a team effort. I can lose this race alone, but **I can only win it with your help** , such as by talking to your friends and neighbors and putting out road signs for me. Most of all, I need your financial support – whether that support is $35 or the maximum $790.00 per person. _The money you donate will be put to good use – for purchasing campaign signs, radio and TV ads, post cards and for get out the vote efforts._
**I am running against a progressive, green new deal liberal, who moved from Chicago to Montana 11 years ago.** Since my opponent moved to Whitefish, he has spent the majority of his time in Montana attacking private industry and, incredibly, during his unsuccessful run for PSC in 2022, he championed a “global warming” regulation agenda. Given that background, can you image what he will do if he is elected auditor in terms of **pushing gun control measures** and **insurance coverage for “transition-related health care.”** More troubling, h**e chooses to be part of a political party that supports open borders, men competing in women’s sports** , and **defunding the police.**
_**I am proud to offer you the clearest possible contrast**_ to that far left agenda.
The primary vote counts don’t lie—**my campaign is off to a great start** , but, now more than ever **I need the help of patriots like you to continue the fight** to keep the office of State Auditor in the hands of Republicans.
To those of you who have already supported my campaign financially, _I can’t thank you enough_ ; and I am asking for a little more help. **I would be honored to receive whatever level of support you can provide** for the coming general election in November. And if you have not previously contributed, **I would be honored to have your financial support.**
**I know these are challenging times for you and your family** , and, frankly, for the entire country due to, **Biden-inflation, the Biden economy, and Bidenomics**. Every contribution is generous; a contribution in these uncertain times is doubly so.
As your Montana friend and your Montana neighbor, I know Montana truly is “The Last Best Place.” I grew up in Montana. I started a business here. And I am familiar with the issues important to you. In keeping with my campaign theme, _I will put your interests first in Helena._ **As auditor, I will give back to the Montana community that has given everything to me and my family for more than 120 years.**
Thank you and God bless.
Yours humbly,
James E. Brown, Esq.
---

subject: The Battle for Truth
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT-L3DAQxT-N3NmM_tm-wsURn9Ps7YWkCKQxWmm8O0SShSQn5NuHC7upr5z5wQ_ee99f11dDnuL1bAJOm89rLms0a0shtY4y2tqa8nMVIFQLQ8v1Khs3AX9ySjU48UFw6PUIQ3Ob8DKAGS5mRIvjRSOAGUeUTmr3pLmWDU3vHhi45j3vlep6vnFlERTXdtg0MAXGY67dlhHdHkx0ni6Y65-Mac-1s3to_HSrNRUmn5lYmFgK2iOj627kfXHGY4fuYGL5fzOxONwwuvYuY3IplskZuAJxBqHE6dOP-W1-efnGRH_UsJb9yBaZnFPeS0JbKV7vKKCjIzA5YzDk709rQjJ0jUzOFFKmQOVB9lgxVibn09v58_rluV1OX9tHD02eXPpN3lPpB6bg-u78l7J-dI1fk_gbAAD__8NRkdw)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT-L3DAQxT-N3NmM_tm-wsURn9Ps7YWkCKQxWmm8O0SShSQn5NuHC7upr5z5wQ_ee99f11dDnuL1bAJOm89rLms0a0shtY4y2tqa8nMVIFQLQ8v1Khs3AX9ySjU48UFw6PUIQ3Ob8DKAGS5mRIvjRSOAGUeUTmr3pLmWDU3vHhi45j3vlep6vnFlERTXdtg0MAXGY67dlhHdHkx0ni6Y65-Mac-1s3to_HSrNRUmn5lYmFgK2iOj627kfXHGY4fuYGL5fzOxONwwuvYuY3IplskZuAJxBqHE6dOP-W1-efnGRH_UsJb9yBaZnFPeS0JbKV7vKKCjIzA5YzDk709rQjJ0jUzOFFKmQOVB9lgxVibn09v58_rluV1OX9tHD02eXPpN3lPpB6bg-u78l7J-dI1fk_gbAAD__8NRkdw).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT-L3DAQxT-N3NmM_tm-wsURn9Ps7YWkCKQxWmm8O0SShSQn5NuHC7upr5z5wQ_ee99f11dDnuL1bAJOm89rLms0a0shtY4y2tqa8nMVIFQLQ8v1Khs3AX9ySjU48UFw6PUIQ3Ob8DKAGS5mRIvjRSOAGUeUTmr3pLmWDU3vHhi45j3vlep6vnFlERTXdtg0MAXGY67dlhHdHkx0ni6Y65-Mac-1s3to_HSrNRUmn5lYmFgK2iOj627kfXHGY4fuYGL5fzOxONwwuvYuY3IplskZuAJxBqHE6dOP-W1-efnGRH_UsJb9yBaZnFPeS0JbKV7vKKCjIzA5YzDk709rQjJ0jUzOFFKmQOVB9lgxVibn09v58_rluV1OX9tHD02eXPpN3lPpB6bg-u78l7J-dI1fk_gbAAD__8NRkdw)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT-L3DAQxT-N3NmM_tm-wsURn9Ps7YWkCKQxWmm8O0SShSQn5NuHC7upr5z5wQ_ee99f11dDnuL1bAJOm89rLms0a0shtY4y2tqa8nMVIFQLQ8v1Khs3AX9ySjU48UFw6PUIQ3Ob8DKAGS5mRIvjRSOAGUeUTmr3pLmWDU3vHhi45j3vlep6vnFlERTXdtg0MAXGY67dlhHdHkx0ni6Y65-Mac-1s3to_HSrNRUmn5lYmFgK2iOj627kfXHGY4fuYGL5fzOxONwwuvYuY3IplskZuAJxBqHE6dOP-W1-efnGRH_UsJb9yBaZnFPeS0JbKV7vKKCjIzA5YzDk709rQjJ0jUzOFFKmQOVB9lgxVibn09v58_rluV1OX9tHD02eXPpN3lPpB6bg-u78l7J-dI1fk_gbAAD__8NRkdw)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
