Hillsdale launched Imprimis over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective. Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, Imprimis is more critical than ever. Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments. On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is simply and clearly un-American. There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says Imprimis is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month. You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are mailed to homes and businesses ten times per year. Our research also shows that Imprimis subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving Imprimis even greater reach and influence. And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--Imprimis has a greater circulation than the Wall Street Journal and The New York Times --we are determined to do more. Since Imprimis launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription. But the fact that we offer Imprimis free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing Imprimis is without cost. Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of Imprimis to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking. Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of Imprimis to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs. Your generous support today will help us reach our Imprimis goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts. You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever! That's why, in addition to Imprimis , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our . These efforts include: Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics. Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week. Educating thousands of K-12 students in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics. I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for Imprimis and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable. Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government. Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. ? If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today. I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as Imprimis , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **. Thank you again for saving young people through education. | | Freedom Liberty Report PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

# **VP Pick is JD Vance: A Threat to Democracy**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u547q-e3x3hy-kyd76rh3/)
---
| | | | This is big news, folks, The selection of JD Vance as Donald Trump's running mate for the 2024 presidential election is a development with serious implications for American democracy. This choice goes beyond mere campaign strategy and tactics, raising critical questions about the future direction of the country. Vance is an election denier who has switched his position on numerous key issues, proving he cannot be trusted with the office of Vice President. JD Vance's political evolution has been marked by a dramatic shift from initial criticism of Trump to becoming one of his most ardent supporters. In 2016, Vance referred to Trump as an “idiot,” “noxious,” and “reprehensible,” questioning whether Trump would be a “cynical a---- like Nixon” or “America’s Hitler.” Once Trump won the election, Vance quickly changed his tune. Vance has since embraced Trump's agenda wholeheartedly. He has articulated a vision for a radical transformation of American governance, suggesting that Trump should overhaul the civil service, replace existing bureaucrats with loyalists, and defy judicial constraints. Vance has proven time and time again that he is willing to pursue extreme measures to achieve his political goals. Vance's role in the Senate and his association with the "New Right," a group advocating for government intervention in cultural and economic matters to advance a right-wing agenda, show his radical agenda for what it is. Vance’s endorsement of foreign authoritarian figures, such as Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, further underscores his anti-democratic inclinations. Orbán’s control over media and educational institutions serves as a model for Vance’s vision of governance, wherein dissenting voices are suppressed, and power is centralized. This authoritarian admiration positions Vance as not merely a supporter of Trump’s ambitions but an active proponent of dismantling democratic institutions around the world. Knowing all of this, we can only imagine what Vance's course of action would have been if he was in Mike Pence's shoes on January 6th. Pence's refusal to support Trump's attempt to overturn the 2020 election was a critical moment in defending democratic norms. In contrast, Vance’s alignment with Trump’s most authoritarian impulses makes him a candidate who would not only comply with but actively pursue anti-democratic actions. JD Vance’s selection as Trump’s running mate is a significant threat to American democracy. [**_Vance poses a substantial threat to democracy. His vision of a government that aggressively pursues a right-wing agenda does not align with what voters around the country need in a Vice President. His presence on the ticket not only bolsters Trump’s chances but also significantly jeopardizes the democratic fabric of the United States. Stand with us in our fight to defeat these election deniers and defend democracy._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u547q-e3x3hz-kyd76rh4/)

body:
Sparknotes

| [](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=eaa68907e1684d02aa7e1adf0d5eab40&_e=6Inj3h_rZr3a_v1QFfu_3FIpWsJc03fYBtoT-nj5HxTQKbtwwGf8UX2BSM3VCnZxsFVV-DHvLR5XDrSYtSyY6uPeV85Kl9ffrQwBnRaQB_6su0AAlc7O6A-VztdaF30P6hoi9M-R9NuxTrp8JHKnjH8-XmWZulaakEfj_KxPf83WfVAWPAnqfmrvDB3MTNeN4XczIats9IaB_f-lTYjtWXBnsdQ8AlkxBLPnJOqiC-CJUI6f9vasYXYFKGNZMX4XJSsvHB3lzbrCZ9B3OEfRXs_i-UYlyres8mbl6Z5aZlSrXQ_EdT5YYQn2urEkzWqC7Jop2vbmmoYlvFZalcGt_jA5ga06Z6q-hjnCi9XYd1znhdWlliHFX7xVL9tnS4rBt1FyqTkWqYpwShWC-CkzesedwM4ACp7mYK5wfoM6HDc%3D)
---
Friends,

I thought I'd take a second to tell you how I got here - a United States Senator for the great state of Ohio. There's so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=eaa68907e1684d02aa7e1adf0d5eab40&_e=6Inj3h_rZr3a_v1QFfu_3FIpWsJc03fYBtoT-nj5HxTQKbtwwGf8UX2BSM3VCnZxsFVV-DHvLR5XDrSYtSyY6uPeV85Kl9ffrQwBnRaQB_6su0AAlc7O6A-VztdaF30P6hoi9M-R9NuxTrp8JHKnjH8-XmWZulaakEfj_KxPf83WfVAWPAnqfmrvDB3MTNeN4XczIats9IaB_f-lTYjtWUdaOx5rYX8WI5YtwGbkNHGZJcrZ_W_w1VBVXJThGJdZqJZrYhwvPKRtvcc2DdBzL0TtERTH99JOTD6Z3FuShcxeojL1t2EdnTHxkOAwdoWem4aHGNi0T9uQmSRvXWT8cORVXroROlOOlvx9MxddabROUMiJYRShLj5EP5FGvfjjVGqJwt7X8WpgQ3FuZY295n0JqmboA4SYkg25yj-KkY8%3D)
This is a photo of me as a child. I grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. I grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=eaa68907e1684d02aa7e1adf0d5eab40&_e=6Inj3h_rZr3a_v1QFfu_3FIpWsJc03fYBtoT-nj5HxTQKbtwwGf8UX2BSM3VCnZxsFVV-DHvLR5XDrSYtSyY6uPeV85Kl9ffrQwBnRaQB_6su0AAlc7O6A-VztdaF30P6hoi9M-R9NuxTrp8JHKnjH8-XmWZulaakEfj_KxPf83WfVAWPAnqfmrvDB3MTNeN4XczIats9IaB_f-lTYjtWUdaOx5rYX8WI5YtwGbkNHGZJcrZ_W_w1VBVXJThGJdZqJZrYhwvPKRtvcc2DdBzL4ggI71yUJm5Jisa1xrfGiDRGnNIFzMvUus6hJ4vLoL0oDYfXmvgkg48kp5-yerNFtwV_itgr5T-e08mHzXdxPQES0fRuGVQnl5Z1sV99jKLrolxLUdGJOsz-McXGQl5hFD4-n4r30bh4BrIlsLZIcU%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents - Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=eaa68907e1684d02aa7e1adf0d5eab40&_e=6Inj3h_rZr3a_v1QFfu_3FIpWsJc03fYBtoT-nj5HxTQKbtwwGf8UX2BSM3VCnZxsFVV-DHvLR5XDrSYtSyY6uPeV85Kl9ffrQwBnRaQB_6su0AAlc7O6A-VztdaF30P6hoi9M-R9NuxTrp8JHKnjH8-XmWZulaakEfj_KxPf83WfVAWPAnqfmrvDB3MTNeN4XczIats9IaB_f-lTYjtWUdaOx5rYX8WI5YtwGbkNHGZJcrZ_W_w1VBVXJThGJdZqJZrYhwvPKRtvcc2DdBzL5sQCEF1O1mhBL4mXO4BkqRo2qtY4stelPeSCrN4z5rYGI8Jny0Eg2zhWC-bjU2oLBxTD8ASljH6bG6IZt2LApRNR0UB07wHl7P2NV932K6UlNcvABr-atJena7gFVzicZonNgIyltubGQDB2FvJZJc%3D)
After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University.

[](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=eaa68907e1684d02aa7e1adf0d5eab40&_e=6Inj3h_rZr3a_v1QFfu_3FIpWsJc03fYBtoT-nj5HxTQKbtwwGf8UX2BSM3VCnZxsFVV-DHvLR5XDrSYtSyY6uPeV85Kl9ffrQwBnRaQB_6su0AAlc7O6A-VztdaF30P6hoi9M-R9NuxTrp8JHKnjH8-XmWZulaakEfj_KxPf83WfVAWPAnqfmrvDB3MTNeN4XczIats9IaB_f-lTYjtWUdaOx5rYX8WI5YtwGbkNHGZJcrZ_W_w1VBVXJThGJdZqJZrYhwvPKRtvcc2DdBzL8_XpmYTnSV3s1skegPoHuhj0MeuJlPg5C9aXIZ9oUlJvWo9P4weXU5s3u7xpX6nhCRKGBOvPBMo3TiOD4tcuNM_UwXzm2CFNNW9VEpjy8DtoAGw4fJw19buAqGSWQngxkK8whRj6j_478vNw1JhXek%3D)
I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together.

My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents - Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream. After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. subject: The Battle for Truth
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2fd44f254ab2451fb0bfe719367a6cd0&_e=xfkNxrVwUGPh6aAzQiaTUT6gjVQ9R3zzJZHNgUYyEUMjjG4W8YI3yo0Cb8ElPTG6v65z5sO2BH0Nd0EWTgZQQk3TQY2ZDiLn2Pa1WBSU6F3IliP3ubHp4UDJfIkuAFLINdQj6COBBv8-LGscj8ZnpNPOP9HGh4T5nFKDkQCJtnXuQ1Ej7nKx6IqMkMzXifc8C-0elg9lCc9UKms9Dr0Sixglsh3xxva5hxU5gKYxWVyBukl9LyBUCh0tG6hj-5Mvv3JEQa6XPioG7ITgfXqZcWLrtA-g83CbAlUnrUggAtzo3wN0vgEAdmDK7W_zJan6kJHg-tkjb76GoMSuldXYrlaZTeOMPmsyP4PqzBUkjwml3BSqUDPAjwUkP1T1yHRkU2hOkvNcmm3NgcDuWAl4nQ%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2fd44f254ab2451fb0bfe719367a6cd0&_e=xfkNxrVwUGPh6aAzQiaTUT6gjVQ9R3zzJZHNgUYyEUMjjG4W8YI3yo0Cb8ElPTG6v65z5sO2BH0Nd0EWTgZQQk3TQY2ZDiLn2Pa1WBSU6F3IliP3ubHp4UDJfIkuAFLINdQj6COBBv8-LGscj8ZnpNPOP9HGh4T5nFKDkQCJtnXuQ1Ej7nKx6IqMkMzXifc8C-0elg9lCc9UKms9Dr0Sixglsh3xxva5hxU5gKYxWVyBukl9LyBUCh0tG6hj-5Mv6PFnB2fpSUBIpbSy7VbDNEut8wmD5iqEx0Oboot2hgwhQjqGV5fvGK_y9gctqICk-_F0O5edINC8wYIT4LDXE4TBloPtqQVOEccQOTZq4Ype3t81TUW2fijDkP359e388InHmUgkN5VJfpnvFR-g2Q%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2fd44f254ab2451fb0bfe719367a6cd0&_e=xfkNxrVwUGPh6aAzQiaTUT6gjVQ9R3zzJZHNgUYyEUMjjG4W8YI3yo0Cb8ElPTG6v65z5sO2BH0Nd0EWTgZQQk3TQY2ZDiLn2Pa1WBSU6F3IliP3ubHp4UDJfIkuAFLINdQj6COBBv8-LGscj8ZnpNPOP9HGh4T5nFKDkQCJtnXuQ1Ej7nKx6IqMkMzXifc8C-0elg9lCc9UKms9Dr0Sixglsh3xxva5hxU5gKYxWVyBukl9LyBUCh0tG6hj-5MvT8aubFgJuKevBODqPoMXFXwn9qBdzbBiXCpFKr_rrVfEiV12SeuSEQlZz7Hh_FkieVDVcsJplNNNm6soaFgVlbhD0THA93HVFyVpop-SufwEOAkXtQAG2HSy4PZM6_-B9XlCJXxGf9Ys-53-rEeWag%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2fd44f254ab2451fb0bfe719367a6cd0&_e=xfkNxrVwUGPh6aAzQiaTUT6gjVQ9R3zzJZHNgUYyEUMjjG4W8YI3yo0Cb8ElPTG6v65z5sO2BH0Nd0EWTgZQQk3TQY2ZDiLn2Pa1WBSU6F3IliP3ubHp4UDJfIkuAFLINdQj6COBBv8-LGscj8ZnpNPOP9HGh4T5nFKDkQCJtnXuQ1Ej7nKx6IqMkMzXifc8C-0elg9lCc9UKms9Dr0Sixglsh3xxva5hxU5gKYxWVyBukl9LyBUCh0tG6hj-5MvTmkqvygMxhE5gl2mSFXAjXAsjG9YAJlZ5CiB1R04aXRfE2IPriJKnurwTITB-T_8arvqGNcbiGTgC4HwpLiCde7Cs5ECtQkfYDtTIxg1IBcL1mBSAidfDqA4m7Hc9qhmhOWYhdWC2qS8u7mqEZLT-w%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Fellow American, Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear. Together, these forces want to circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity , and push their own false and dishonest narrative about American history and about what's happening today. More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed." We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America! The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities. It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley. We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education. Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem. A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty. Hillsdale launched Imprimis over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective. Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, Imprimis is more critical than ever. Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments. On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is simply and clearly un-American. There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says Imprimis is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month. You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are mailed to homes and businesses ten times per year. Our research also shows that Imprimis subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving Imprimis even greater reach and influence. And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--Imprimis has a greater circulation than the Wall Street Journal and The New York Times --we are determined to do more. Since Imprimis launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription. But the fact that we offer Imprimis free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing Imprimis is without cost. Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of Imprimis to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking. Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of Imprimis to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs. Your generous support today will help us reach our Imprimis goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts. You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever! That's why, in addition to Imprimis , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our . These efforts include: Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics. Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week. Educating thousands of K-12 students in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics. I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for Imprimis and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable. Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government. Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. ? If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today. body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95b61f5a5cc44e55acb6eb896daefda7&_e=6jCeZC5hmxnR8LvQ5laoTN-7Jov_ZSODPsy0NMNYZI6wETH0EKDwViJwuI7dLTcwWrK32o_zDLa5twVvPrJAOOjpZs29ZUZzoA8CCRPVCQrm4zWWV2SjDw2GT5G8Cs0PzNG21EjLmeXtfiJreLdmR3HvjhPHLLRZUy8H7fZcdG69BnnlKLAE0HRE4esUfaw35XEZQCFbMrieVpHaGAzh_z1RfVif7cbJOCXL0LA_UsfB0V_O29r9CPs5xq0zBfB0Q1eIOqUFFQwGaMauzBxgQWOTHLNECYzqXCeOof88mc2a79yQ285tKkSWGRL43VdaVjj1ldq7SYJmyMFu0XXCfiwr-Hs3fUaqtaDcYJIWBl3TOBq3or0MMrd3EbfgvXRlxawvBlkpO7plW3r_ZzLNOg%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. clean_body: = Team, Last week we were so proud to announce the remaining members of the Class of 2024 Party Builder Award honorees. Earlier this year the IDCCA honored Tom Balanoff, President Emeritus of SEIU Local 1, House Assistant Majority Leader Kam Buckner, and Senate Assistant Majority Leader Linda Holmes with the 2024 Party Builder Award. Adding to the Class of 2024, the IDCCA is excited to announce former IDCCA President Doug House and IDCCA Vice President Pam Davidson have been selected to receive this year’s Party Builder Award, and they will be honored at the 2024 Annual County Chairs’ Brunch on Wednesday, August 14th at the BOS Center in Springfield. (=) = = Former IDCCA President and former Rock Island County Democratic Party Chair Doug House has led a life of public service. His 44-year career includes retired Deputy Secretary of the Illinois Department of Transportation, former President of the Illinois American Public Works Association, and a 33-year Township elected official. In 2023, he was inducted into the AFL-CIO Organized Labor Hall of Fame. = = = IDCCA Vice President and Knox County Democratic Party Chair Pam Davidson has been known to get into “good trouble” throughout her career. The former Knox County Board Chair and current County Board Member has been a dedicated political activist and community leader in her native home of Galesburg. While employed at John Deere Harvester Works, she is an active member of United Auto Workers Local 865. Expanding her commitment to building the Democratic Party throughout Illinois, in 2022 she was elected State Central Committeewoman for the 17th Congressional District to the Democratic Party of Illinois. = = Our Annual County Chairs Brunch is our opportunity to celebrate our great work this year, and start thinking ahead to the November election and strategize about how we’ll win County races around the state. Friends,

I thought I'd take a second to tell you how I got here - a United States Senator for the great state of Ohio. There's so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._

[](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZevrTRWVDabByt6BqmxY4qhEVHbQeGgfG7GItCYXqMww7HVSWin0NtlfhII2o6ZEBn-ik7F1NuyQPCO28VuIfF0xVyla1ZOw9yJzTL_xUFN5nP-MPPGV-CELTslV47KwVxDWCQkfAtd2QxPGh2a8yhEg_8dJgDCz_3NOd12tlfTIZdO6ysxw7ao8xMsSDVsh4Q%3D)
This is a photo of me as a child. I grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. I grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.

[](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZevrTRWVDabByt6BqmxY4qhEVHbQeGgfG7GItCYXqMww699pojn8hQEocHv0m2RvZFUGukfdfjdBd_jv63Lj-fdklsSwL96YQa9LL4-AFGzzKawqcbLRPKjeQRq13cdMFftfBZ_bryZqIa9zhpU9VnwnaTu0nqMYeKSEzE1PwvnCx9rNr70Yv_VspMmPvIpZGw%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents - Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.

[](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZevrTRWVDabByt6BqmxY4qhEVHbQeGgfG7GItCYXqMwwwZFqngvAWtqhRfeSG-zC2G5lRbYifV_bykewDtgWwwAmia_BhkXZAKqC4u6gDUuxLnC8i8rhaUuVx4JTSSSW4YXSZYfpwgcLfaKHLEGUi0JtYcHzzOTYOVurid1rCZwPkXLylJVvrC_VUx9KqepqAE%3D)
After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University.

[](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZevrTRWVDabByt6BqmxY4qhEVHbQeGgfG7GItCYXqMwwy_gtIvDYIFCP2cBbLYC1zqR_DvQkFyaQeg7zHFiZfuzMqs3JSQPPbaaNnDrxaQ94DClYmkKZHR7hO35jtRekmK_bAY5AUzisWHEFjn2541_eueM7XZMZDNBobruxnuiDxaXoAM0b_y76mYX_ygABqg%3D)
I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together.

[](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZevrTRWVDabByt6BqmxY4qhEVHbQeGgfG7GItCYXqMww6T7GpOREJNtWB_10_t6dWBfmi-hR-YRyNNYBNg5WyVW5Yx17xVSayNSEhQQJSslBh_utH2JL5nb2FKOCO22s7bJc7WbF_Ldnp0hyYZn-_rVFCYlNZtaDR7UB4eJBJEk5PnvZPl8ZA8mLaKVSZUDiuE%3D)
All of this brought me to where I am right now - a Senator in the United States Senate. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I've seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent.

I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately - they fail themselves. It's an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots - my family - my hometown - are what got me here. The good and the bad.

[](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZevrTRWVDabByt6BqmxY4qhEVHbQeGgfG7GItCYXqMww1fDeH3j971AUAnqySxu0BQhWvP0DR_9G5c7QaiT7tidGVqoZ-_Sb6bZJ3s_19EMwE2E1aVi78uZgfJfT7AiqTNsh4dLYwM7bQyQWJPb5UQJLGryP-CSRP5VwKiWkC9rk3NggahrOhupYcqsDGgldEk%3D)
I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs leaders who know what it's like to live in a left-behind community, not career politicans who do nothing for the American people.

I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of why I ran for U.S. Senate: **leave no Ohioan behind.**

[**_It's the honor of my life to serve you in the Senate, and I hope you can make a donation today. It would truly mean the world to me._**](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZevrTRWVDabByt6BqmxY4qhEVHbQeGgfG7GItCYXqMww-t-7nvSImzkyt6Utzgt-XBLg_W9lwuiOc9vbHiz31m8eJpDFlrjRC5XymW8OjRJiFkFLChKLE9L4_E7V9wH-H1jszcnaP8QbKdHylwMCHkhPyES4aN2PYh58t72Cm2IGru95_v0E13wHhmP3V2feQ4%3D)

| [**JOIN TEAM JD!**](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2fd9ce3b7ecd49a08d3cc2015491b945&_e=gUO_FgaGH5l_vRiGouJ6Gdjd4-ak1iNkJUWON74msgTUVG6DShKVzXU-hdvK6MiNwBVX-VJq1Vb2En8o-O3UeePtKCy11cfAV3yePHxj0c4IlqcOFvlos50yCBx1ElPSvuZcu8orWLvG78t-ttxHtZP7kWDXcTlTbNsxArnWlmNZaiPT5dr3TNtI-SBYQew4iq4Xco8imag8IDxvZNiAVq4LW4Oe5jD-zY35iZKN7ZfzRU9HBDiS7aKVrOp9ZOqps6ygDiwqvhK8rKcyWrbXPRj60gTfOg_fMYybVfVQw_RD10OSsAwRes1XVXMiD3w5iaNBaiKmUntXtOnFvJ8ilpQmLBXX9l2j9KhyX8VvwAE3TXD2gvbjdpKEYG8x3eYexlJZL81IFzgCAsxm9MLdhSXhiwlIsA074DppOmZe6tQ%3D)

God bless,

JD Vance

**Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author.**
Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our
economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans.
Ohio needs JD Vance.

body:
It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g8Q8f1HRsZJIs3_6OecNUQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoeACmP0RRaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVJPTjUxNTgxVwNzcGNCCmaSmWeVZiXXJhtSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/g8Q8f1HRsZJIs3_6OecNUQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoeACmP0RRaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPVJPTjUxNTgxVwNzcGNCCmaSmWeVZiXXJhtSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. Hi Friend,

**_I haven't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do._**

I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work.

In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector.

Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. **They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America.**

This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them.

It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

subject: We settle our disputes at the ballot box
disclaimer_text: Paid for by DePasquale for AG
body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88925438/485593018/-531765509?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NTE3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDY2N2Y0Yi1kODQyLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I_v6uqlhRSZM_qeS7Un4jcYWFsjzXC_0NhH7SRrop78=&emci=ae9f5454-c342-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=f0667f4b-d842-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=10203249) We settle our disputes at the ballot box. The democratic process can be difficult and fraught, but the success and health of our Democracy is predicated on a peaceful discourse. The apparent assassination attempt on former President Trump is unacceptable. Political violence has no place in this election and no place in our community. There must be a thorough investigation to determine exactly what happened and how it happened. Anyone involved must be fully held accountable. I am confident that our law enforcement will work closely with the FBI and Secret Service to conduct a thorough and complete investigation into the events of last weekend. Troopers & officers who put their own lives on the line to protect Pennsylvanians and the former President are heroes. The gunman could have killed dozens of innocent people. It didn’t happen because of brave law enforcement officers. I’m proud of them & recognize their heroism. Gun violence is a scourge on our communities and we must not allow ourselves to accept it as normal. Every day, more than 120 Americans are killed with guns and more than 200 are shot and wounded. We must commit ourselves to bringing about an end to this uniquely American tragedy. I am glad the former President was not seriously harmed. My heart goes out to those killed and injured in last weekend's violence. Eugene DePasquale

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jim Jordan has betrayed our veterans
body:
https://www.tamiewilson.com/ [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Friends,
Jim Jordan has turned his back on our veterans. It's time we stand up and say, "Enough is enough!"
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240715_veterans_image1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240715_veterans_image1]
As the granddaughter of a WW-II veteran and a former military spouse, I’ve lived the military life and understand the unique struggles these families face.
I also know firsthand the mental and physical health challenges our veterans face and the difficulties they encounter in accessing healthcare. My heart broke when I discovered that veterans are the most affected demographic for homelessness, addiction, and suicide.
This drives my commitment to fight for our veterans, ensuring they receive the support and respect they deserve.
We deserve leaders who truly stand by our veterans, not with empty words, but with concrete actions that deliver the healthcare, mental health support, and resources they need to live a good life – a life they have earned through their sacrifice. Contribute today to support a campaign dedicated to honoring those who served. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240715_veterans_link1]
Jim Jordan has consistently failed our veterans.
He has voted against legislation aimed at improving their lives, including the PACT Act, which was designed to provide healthcare and benefits to veterans exposed to toxic burn pits.
His vote against this bill was unconscionable and a direct betrayal of those who have sacrificed so much for our country.
It’s clear he prefers to support an agenda that ignores the needs of our veterans so that he can spend his time weaponizing our government attacking those trying to hold Trump accountable.
Jordan’s ultra-MAGA ideology is a danger to federal employees, many of whom are veterans. He advocates for pay freezes, staffing reductions, and government shutdowns.
These actions not only disrespect veterans but also jeopardize their well-being, financial stability, and food and home security.
Our veterans deserve a representative who will fight for their rights and ensure they receive the care and support they need.
Recently, I honored our veterans at the Logan County Fair by supporting Soldier Solutions, an organization that provides service dogs for disabled veterans.
Unlike my opponent, I will continue to prove my dedication to making a tangible difference in the lives of those who have served our nation.

We cannot let Jim Jordan’s neglect continue.
We need leaders in Congress who will stand up for our veterans and protect their interests. Your support for our campaign can help make this a reality. Contribute today to help us build a Congress that honors our veterans and demands they receive the respect and care they deserve. Tamie Wilson

name: With Honor Action
subject: Veterans in Congress: Statements on the Assassination Attempt on Former President Trump
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WITH HONOR ACTION, INC
body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b9862ac4a4d6/invitation-two-parties-two-veterans-one-conversation-rep-lalota-rep-ryan-special-session-with-president-carter-alumni-13542158?e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| | | |
---
| | | | Friends and Colleagues,

Like all of you, I was stunned to see the news of the assassination attempt on former President Trump this weekend as I returned from travel abroad.

Political violence has corresponded with the rise of nationalism in the U.S. and around the world. The Journal of Democracy has a useful resource page with recent research on the rise of political violence in the U.S. It is [linked here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=471424cf00&e=33f53a5b1a). Consider this chart from the second article on the page.
---
|
---
| The assassination attempt likely makes our work both more urgent and difficult. It is difficult for most public institutions, companies, and nonprofits alike that try to maintain an apolitical or bipartisan approach while doing work that affects Americans from all walks of life. So many issues and moments in America are now politicized and pulled into culture wars. Many Democrats and Republicans believe the upcoming election is, as Axios founder Mike Allen observed yesterday, an existential battle for America and humanity. Allen writes, "People don't threaten civil wars over COLA adjustments for Social Security recipients. They do it to save the nation and our species."

Below is [the statement ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=d84b00607e&e=33f53a5b1a)we released as an organization. The Members in Congress we support made immediate public statements as well that condemned the violence and called for unity. Some of them are below, including the Co-Chairs of the bipartisan For Country Caucus that With Honor Action works alongside.
---
| _With Honor wishes former President Trump a full and fast recovery and condemns all forms of violence to achieve political goals. Our country is in a dangerous place. We urgently need public leaders to do more work across political divides, turn the temperature down on vitriolic, hateful rhetoric, and speak the truth._
---
| These initial public voices are important, as are bipartisan actions. We seek to elevate and maintain them, though we recognize it may not be easy to do in the turbulent months -- if not years -- ahead. Analogies to 1938 and the risk of global conflict are, I believe, appropriate. Rep. Jake Ellzey, a Navy fighter pilot and For Country Caucus Member, spoke about this and the risk of global conflict in [these remarks](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=705d77c73b&e=33f53a5b1a) he made on the floor last week after returning from the Baltics.

---
| | | | |
---
[Statement from the For Country Caucus by the Co-Chairs Rep. Crow, U.S. Army veteran and Rep. Tony Gonzales, U.S. Navy veteran:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=5f63b2ecb7&e=33f53a5b1a)

"Political violence is unacceptable and has no place in our society. We are thankful President Trump is safe. Our thoughts and prayers are with President Trump, the victims’ families, and all those who were in attendance at the event in Butler, PA yesterday. To restore civility, our elected leaders must dial down dangerous rhetoric and seek to unite our nation. In unity lies our greatest strength."

Rep Jason Crow also appeared on Face the Nation this Sunday. This is a l[ink to his remarks](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=64a5e9e58a&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| |
---
[Governor Wes Moore, veteran, U.S. Army](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=a5a2920350&e=33f53a5b1a):

"I condemn in the strongest possible terms what has happened in Pennsylvania today to President Trump. Political violence is never acceptable. Ever. This kind of cowardice must be roundly condemned by all Americans. We have to be a country that can learn to disagree without turning to political violence. I am praying for President Trump’s safety and recovery. Our nation is and must be better than this."
---
| |
---
[Rep Don Bacon, veteran, U.S. Air Force and founding Co-Chair of the For Country Caucus:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ec3ac37123&e=33f53a5b1a)

"Our nation has been rocked by this assassination attempt. While we’re thankful that President Trump is okay we are mourning for the family who lost a loved one. We’re also praying for the quick recovery of the other victims and send our thanks to the Secret Service who raced to protect President Trump, as well as law enforcement and first responders. I absolutely condemn all political violence, to include this vile attack. Furthermore, we lift this nation up in prayer that we can come together to heal and move past the hyper partisanship that weakens our nation."
---
| |
---
[Rep Jimmy Panetta, veteran, U.S. Navy and founding Co-Chair of the For Country Caucus:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=eb38770a98&e=33f53a5b1a)

"I am closely monitoring the apparent attack in Pennsylvania on former President Donald Trump. His campaign states that he is safe and secure, and I am grateful for the Secret Service and first responders for their work to ensure his safety. We pray for the former president and any other victims of the apparent attack. As a nation, we must unequivocally reject all forms of political violence."
---
| |
---
[Rep Mikie Sherrill, veteran, U.S. Navy, Vice Chair of the For Country Caucus:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=8e9f1a1113&e=33f53a5b1a)

"I am horrified to learn of the situation at today’s rally in Pennsylvania. I hope Donald Trump and all those attending are safe, and am grateful for law enforcement's quick response. There is no place for political violence in America."
---
| |
---
[Rep Mariannette Miller-Meeks, veteran, U.S. Army, Vice Chair of the For Country Caucus:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=83b5534337&e=33f53a5b1a)

"Tragic learning there’s one fatality and 2 injured in addition to Trump in Butler, PA. I pray for them & their families. I’m grateful for the Secret Service, LEO’s and first responders; thank you. Importantly, I absolutely condemn political violence. It is never acceptable! Solve differences at the ballot box."
---
| |
---
[Senator Mark Kelly, veteran, U.S. Navy, With Honor Action supported bipartisan veteran in the Senate:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=121fd0016c&e=33f53a5b1a)

"Gabby and I are horrified by the incident in Pennsylvania. No one should ever have to experience political violence — we know that firsthand. We’re keeping former President Trump, his family, and everyone involved in our thoughts."
---
| |
---
[Senator Todd Young, veteran, U.S. Marine Corps, With Honor Action supported bipartisan veteran in the Senate:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=48a1a8ce38&e=33f53a5b1a)

"A terrifying scene at President Trump’s event this afternoon. Praying that he and all in attendance are ok and that calm will prevail. Violence is never the answer."
---
| |
---
[Rep. Salud Carbajal, veteran, U.S. Marine Corps, Vice Chair of the For Country Caucus in the 117th Congress:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=6990a4fa69&e=33f53a5b1a)

"While we await for more details on this horrifying attack, we must stand together and say with a unified voice: political violence has no place in America. Grateful for the quick actions of law enforcement today. My thoughts are with Donald Trump, his family, & all affected."
---
| |
---
[Rep. Steve Womack, veteran, U.S. Army National Guard, Member of the For Country Caucus and recipient of the With Honor Action 2023 Principles Before Politics Award:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=9b0d916962&e=33f53a5b1a)

"My prayers continue to be with President Trump and the innocent Americans who were exercising their Constitutional rights and caught in this heartbreaking act of violence. I’m grateful for the swift response of secret service. There is no place for political violence in this country."
---
| |
---
[Rep. Chrissy Houlahan, veteran, U.S. Air Force, Founding Vice Chair of the For Country Caucus:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=5f1c12a560&e=33f53a5b1a)

"I’m heartened to hear that it appears the former President is safe after today’s attack in PA. I want to thank the Secret Service for their quick and decisive actions. There is still a great deal that we don’t know, but what we all do know is that there is no place for violence."
---
| |
---
[Rep. Zach Nunn, veteran, U.S. Air Force, member of the For Country Caucus:](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=48f22b4cbd&e=33f53a5b1a)

"Last night’s act of violence was horrific and has no place in our country. Now is the time for unity and helping those in need. As we pray for President Trump, the victims, & families, please consider donating to support the victims as they recover:"
---
|
---
| Please visit With Honor's new website at [www.withhonor.org](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=c4fb01fd3e&e=33f53a5b1a) and consider forwarding this to a friend who may be interested in learning -- and doing -- more for our country.
---
| | | | | | [](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=7dc75e933e&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| | [](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=10c862684f&e=33f53a5b1a)
---

---
|
---
| _With Honor Action fights polarization in Congress by supporting principled veterans across party lines who pledge to service with integrity, civility, and courage. With Honor Action works alongside the bipartisan For Country Caucus in Congress to pass critical legislation for our nation. Learn more about our work at WithHonor.org _ _With Honor Action is a 501(c)(4), which serves as the organization’s policy and social-welfare arm.

body:
To view this email as a web page, click
https://view.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=aa5c2f55ddc1238bef8ff101ead3d62b8d38aad348f5b01488b28dbc95fe586acd678a7bf6c53d6a72fe4316d113356307880a1d17f1b28f00abde729ee4af24dd2e0792ca944f70f15c092814493b10
here.

Dear Friend,

Tonight, I had the honor of addressing my fellow Americans in Milwaukee, Wisconsin at the Republican National Convention.

I just left the stage at the RNC, and let me tell you - we are unifying now more than ever behind electing Donald J. Trump the 47th President of the United States.

The energy on the convention floor left me with a sense of hope and optimism - that this is a moment to unite as Americans to safeguard our country’s position as that shining city on a hill, and that every American is ready to seize this moment.

I prayed for America and our people, asking our Lord Almighty that He bring together this great country around our shared belief - that we are indivisible as one nation under God.

During my speech, I talked about how President Trump led by working to lower taxes, slash regulations, deliver record low unemployment for all Americans, and lift 2.4 million Americans out of poverty.

America was a land rich in opportunity under President Trump’s commonsense leadership, and we can make America the land of opportunity once again this November.

When I left my business career to run for Governor of Virginia, I knew we could put Virginia on the path to prosperity just like President Trump did for our entire country.

We provided $5 billion in tax relief, cut red tape, created more than 240,000 jobs, attracted companies large and small to move to Virginia, brought excellence back into our education system with parents at the head seat of the table, and Backed the Blue.

Now, CNBC just named Virginia the Top State in America for Business. We regained this honor by helping people keep more of their hard-earned money, because that money belongs to them and not the government. We freed our job creators from the crushing burden of overregulation. We made record investments in, and prioritized, behavioral health and education - Virginia was ranked first in the nation in education by CNBC as well.

We are demonstrating that commonsense conservative leadership works and it wins. Now, it’s time to deliver that leadership back to the White House by rallying behind Donald Trump.

Friend, every poll out of Virginia shows this race is neck-and-neck. In a state Joe Biden won by 10 points just four years ago, it is clear that Donald Trump can win Virginia. We can do something that has not happened in two decades - deliver Virginia’s 13 electoral votes for a Republican President.

| | | **OFFICIAL STATEMENT** **Susie Lee spews verifiably false, inflammatory rhetoric that leads to political violence.** _Even after the tragic events in Pennsylvania, Susie keeps pedaling the dangerous lies that brought us to this point in American politics._ July 15, 2024 Contact: [info@drewfornevada.com](mailto:press@drewfornevada.com) (**Las Vegas, NV**) – "Following Saturday's assassination attempt on President Donald Trump, in which the President was shot through the ear and retired Buffalo Township Fire Chief Corey Comperatore was tragically killed, Susie Lee, my opponent for Nevada's 3rd congressional district, posted on social media that 'Political violence of any kind can never be tolerated in America.' I completely agree with that statement. But recently, Lee and other Nevada Democrats have intentionally sought to demonize me and sow the seeds of division with lies that accuse me of:
* Wanting to imprison women for having abortions, even though I strongly oppose a federal abortion ban and respect Nevada's laws.
* Sympathizing with the KKK, despite serving on a state Civil Rights Commission and volunteering hundreds of hours to reduce the overrepresentation of minorities in the criminal justice system.
* Threatening the rights of the LGBTQ community, when I was one of the first conservative leaders in America to support gay marriage and advocate for same-sex adoption.
* Planning to reduce Social Security and Medicare benefits, even though I have devoted my career to eliminating wasteful spending and redirecting those savings to make entitlements solvent in the future.

Susie Lee's and other Democrats' disgusting lies and inflammatory fearmongering fuel the hatred and divisiveness that result in political violence like we saw in Pennsylvania. I challenge Susie Lee to stop the lies and provide her vision for improving our divided country based on legitimate differences between us. I invite her to join me in waging a truthful, decent, fact-based campaign._" _\- **Nevada Congressional District 3 candidate Drew Johnson** _###_

#
Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? I'm asking 50 people to step forward today with a $50 gift to help us put our life-saving videos into classrooms nationwide**. **[https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=cb3ee1f0153e402d9fc15f655b128114&_e=-D2MwZap55udJoXS1EQbs5iorsUp6zTnwY-CXjUzgkEOcHJQMkTyb3HbxJ49vHcRe9ZsDwXDBqxMALVaEBk_lGLwnQzQtF7-QKEQeOsFRdiDMGI7sf8MsuGL0X1rgVFW8ikmvumH5FRfjykbktX_1a6PXznBuElO-xNi1IaA9MFHd0y1EwmoPgKDrDVSMv6ff-Xv0lXTNdAn3UtczVLdGmoPhNLZJjH3T6KXiATecM__fQYn9Vau9pZRZzrLv-K8lNSfP5lDmn9kSyG0H_I2KfnvSYoOfaXBFszd4kswBwjx6eqZ3a39dSGvJMduPs7taUJG29TFXaZf95glu76tcekfxnyry7AOqQzQH5hwB7E%3D)**

Planned Parenthood has continuously pushed egregious and pornographic materials in schools to young kids and teens -- and what do they "teach" these impressionable kids about sex? That disturbing practices are "normal" and "healthy."

In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Friend of Life, this is why we at Live Action have been creating - and are about to release! - wholesome sex-ed video series for schools across the country to use instead of Planned Parenthood's damaging materials.

We need to spread the truth about loving relationships between men and women and the beauty of procreation before the next generation of parents is convinced by Planned Parenthood's disturbing agenda that leads to abortion.

**But we can 't complete this critical initiative without your support. Your gift of $50 will help us complete the videos and get them into schools across the country. Use this secure link to make your gift and kick Planned Parenthood out of the classroom! [https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=cb3ee1f0153e402d9fc15f655b128114&_e=-D2MwZap55udJoXS1EQbs5iorsUp6zTnwY-CXjUzgkEOcHJQMkTyb3HbxJ49vHcRe9ZsDwXDBqxMALVaEBk_lGLwnQzQtF7-QKEQeOsFRdiDMGI7sf8MsuGL0X1rgVFW8ikmvumH5FRfjykbktX_1a6PXznBuElO-xNi1IaA9MFHd0y1EwmoPgKDrDVSMv6ff-Xv0lXTNdAn3UtczVLdGoY1MktqCUNg-tVwR0lUyU-mu1M2_BRkxlrJHeF0yFlGbQ_6yffs7G5nJZubNBckmHKCgpDeVG2sJ6SWMo3r4uMu8TFjYiH348UeuaXnQHsPttiavflbnoQTQKDOaLIs3pz-sVqg0yZoHVSvntVVsow%3D)

For Life,

Lila Rose

name: Cori Bush
subject: In my own words
body:
#
Hi Peter,
I never intended to run for office. I never thought that politics was for someone like me.
I’m the daughter of a former union meat-cutter, a formerly unhoused single mother of two, and a survivor of gun violence, domestic violence, and sexual assault.
But when Michael Brown was killed by a white police officer in Ferguson, Missouri, in 2014, I couldn’t stand by. For more than 400 days, I stood shoulder to shoulder with our community as a nurse, as a pastor, and as an activist on the frontlines of the movement to save Black lives.
Our community was suffering, with parts of St. Louis seeing decades of underinvestment. It was clear that the status quo wasn’t working for our families, our children, and for regular, everyday people. So my community came together and asked me to run, and against all odds, I defeated a 52-year political dynasty. Not only that, but together, we made history. I became the first nurse and first Black woman to ever represent Missouri in federal office.
**Since taking office in 2021, I’ve seen the power our movement holds.** When we come together, we’re a force of nature. I’ve been proud to testify before Congress about my personal abortion story, co-found the country’s first Equal Rights Amendment Caucus, introduce legislation to hold Republican insurrectionists accountable for trying to overthrow our democracy, took direct action on the steps of the U.S. Capitol to keep 11 million people housed, and introduced transformative legislation like a Green New Deal for Cities and the People’s Response Act, which takes a holistic approach to public safety. And I did all of that while delivering more than $2 billion and counting back home for everyday people in St. Louis, and passing over 25 pieces of legislation.
We can take on the establishment, we can bring billions of dollars home to our district, we can legislate to transform people’s lives, and we can push our **pro-peace, pro-humanity** movement into the national and international spotlight.
But to keep up this work, I need your help ensuring that my campaign has the resources to defeat far-right billionaires in the primary and all the way to November. In fact, one of my opponents is quietly taking donations from the same GOP donors who gave to Josh Hawley, Nikki Haley, and Donald Trump’s campaigns.
**[Will you help build up the momentum for my re-election campaign by splitting a donation between Justice Democrats and my own today?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240715-cb.HqvloJ&refcode=em20240715-35758&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1&akid=35758%2E1203867%2EKiHpES)**
Thanks again for being a part of this movement. I can’t wait to see what we accomplish, _together._
Congresswoman Cori Bush

When I found out Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy was running for Senate in Montana, I knew I needed to help this decorated warfighter and true patriot defeat the Washington establishment incumbent, Jon Tester.

body:
https://shariceforcongress.com/ [https://shariceforcongress.com/] I know so many of my fellow Americans are shaken by the horrific violence we witnessed over the weekend. I wanted to take a moment to share my thoughts with you:

Let me start with this: Political violence is never acceptable. We all have a responsibility to forcefully condemn the attack on former President Trump.

I am relieved that the former president is okay, and I’m grateful to the Secret Service and law enforcement who responded and are investigating. I’m also deeply saddened to know that an attendee at the rally was killed. I’m thinking of his family today, and wishing for a swift recovery for those who were injured, including the former president.

As we grapple with these dark events, I’m also mindful that we are still facing an election in less than four months’ time — one whose outcome will have a huge impact on our community, and on every single person in our nation.

All of us — whether candidates like me, or our incredible, passionate supporters — can, and must, make the case for our vision for the future peacefully and clearly, never losing sight of the fact that those who disagree with us are fellow human beings who deserve safety, empathy, and respect. Remembering that fact isn’t just important for avoiding further acts of violence, but it’s also critical for getting anything done.

This will be a competitive election, here in KS-03 and across the country. One that will require a lot of hard work. It’s normal for elections like this to bring out strong emotions. But no one should ever face violence because of what they believe or what candidates they support.

So as we move forward, let’s make sure we do so in a way that reflects the values we hold dear in our democracy.

Thank you,

Sharice

As we grapple with these dark events, I’m also mindful that we are still facing an election in less than four months’ time — one whose outcome will have a huge impact on our community, and on every single person in our nation. All of us — whether candidates like me, or our incredible, passionate supporters — can, and must, make the case for our vision for the future peacefully and clearly, never losing sight of the fact that those who disagree with us are fellow human beings who deserve safety, empathy, and respect. Remembering that fact isn’t just important for avoiding further acts of violence, but it’s also critical for getting anything done. This will be a competitive election, here in KS-03 and across the country. One that will require a lot of hard work. It’s normal for elections like this to bring out strong emotions. But no one should ever face violence because of what they believe or what candidates they support. So as we move forward, let’s make sure we do so in a way that reflects the values we hold dear in our democracy. Thank you, Sharice

Hours after a registered Republican white male shooter with a legally purchased firearm shot at Donald Trump, Ohio Senator JD Vance [tweeted the below](https://substack.com/redirect/9e12e5c8-5221-4567-98af-ff540371bab8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):

In particular, Vance condemned the shooting and declared it the result of the Biden campaign's premise that "_President Donald Trump is an authoritarian fascist who must be stopped at all costs_." There's only one problem with Vance's allegation. That is, it wasn't President Biden's 2024 Presidential campaign that loudly compared Donald Trump to Adolf Hitler--it was JD Vance himself in 2016.
**Let 's Address This.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..i0ZDd0xb0-xb9pZaaqJXtEEvaBCV1oljLzk8FJmE564?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146646635)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9ebcf56e-d9a3-49bf-86ac-6603dda7d5f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[JD Vance publicly declared](https://substack.com/redirect/d98ec097-3896-4969-bf39-0a563fbb63b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in response to Donald Trump's first run for President:
> I go back and forth between thinking Trump might be a cynical asshole like Nixon who wouldn't be that bad (and might even prove useful) or that he might be America's Hitler. How's that for discouraging?
Vance additionally described Trump as "idiot," "noxious," and "reprehensible." I have to say I agree. Therefore, while Vance now speaks of the need to decrease political violence and dangerous political rhetoric--when unclouded by the promise of unimpeachable power--JD Vance himself compared Donald Trump to Adolf Hitler. And now Vance remarkably blames others for agreeing with him, when he should be taking a victory lap for calling out Trump's fascism before most anyone else on the right did.
Since comparing Trump to Hitler, Vance has of course aggressively flipped the script, and now proudly embraces Donald Trump and his fascism. And now, Donald Trump rewards that loyalty as only a fascist in chief could--by selecting JD Vance as his vice president running mate for the 2024 election.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/433a0596-f35f-41d4-99f7-658fdceaeb71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
